profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website describes self-driving freight powered by the Aurora Driver, which the company says combines hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and can be integrated into a customer's fleet. The site frames the technology as a way to deliver the benefits of self-driving safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site carries testimonials from partners rather than product detail. One describes a pilot program hauling freight autonomously between Fort Worth and El Paso, and another says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. A third refers to a hybrid model combining Werner professional drivers with the Aurora Driver, and a fourth says the system has performed over millions of autonomous miles. The company describes autonomous trucks as a response to projected freight growth and as a way to move longer and less desirable routes off human drivers.

Beyond the site, the company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001828108. Litigation exposure recorded for the company is concentrated in Pennsylvania, with a count of 174. No lawsuits are listed against it in the available case data.
